$comment: The frozen project graph. ADR 0001 prints this table; rule A7 asserts multiset equality
between the resolved checkout and this file, so an edge added without amending ADR 0001
fails, and so does an edge the ADR promises that the checkout no longer has.
Generated at VM-0 and hand-maintained thereafter; the docs test asserting that the
printed table matches this file is deferred to VM-6.
VM-1 adds the two test-only projects ADR 0001's budget permits - the composition-root host
and the behavioural contract suite - taking the graph from 5 projects and 8 edges to 7 and
16. It adds ZERO packable assemblies: the packable set stays exactly the three product
packages, and a fourth PackageId before VM-3 requires a dated revision of ADR 0001.

VM-2 adds the one test-only project ADR 0001's budget permits it - a fuzz target host - taking the graph from 7 projects and 16 edges to 8 and 20. That is the ceiling the record names: 5 test-only projects and 8 in total. It adds ZERO packable assemblies, so the packable set is still exactly the three product packages.

VM-3 adds the four projects ADR 0001 revision 1 authorises - two application-local consumer profiles and two named composition roots - taking the graph from 8 projects and 20 edges to 12 and 33, and test-only projects from 5 to 7. It adds ZERO packable assemblies: the packable set is still exactly the three product packages. The composition roots are the only projects permitted to reference a profile assembly, which is the deployment boundary src/compositions/ exists to enforce.

VM-4 adds the one test-only project ADR 0001 revision 2 authorises - a soak host whose managed heap and working set are sampled over a long lifecycle run - taking the graph from 12 projects and 33 edges to 13 and 37, and test-only projects from 7 to 8. It adds ZERO packable assemblies, so the packable set is still exactly the three product packages.

VM-5 adds the one test-only project ADR 0001 revision 3 authorises - an uninstrumented benchmark host that publishes what the core costs a profile - taking the graph from 13 projects and 37 edges to 14 and 41, and test-only projects from 8 to 9. It adds ZERO packable assemblies, so the packable set is still exactly the three product packages. It references no benchmarking package: a framework's own warmup, pilot and outlier policies would be part of every figure the component publishes and none of them would be visible in this repository.

JS-0 adds the three project shells the JavaScript profile's own ADR-equivalent decision JSD-0001 authorises - the format assembly, the profile assembly and the lowering - taking the graph from 14 projects and 41 edges to 17 and 46, and product projects from 3 to 6. It adds ZERO packable assemblies: all three declare IsPackable false and no PackageId, so the packable set is still exactly the three core packages and rule A6 still counts three. The profile assembly references Abstractions, Binary and its own format sibling, which ADR 0011 P1's 2026-08-31 revision admits; the lowering references Abstractions and the format and never the profile, which is what makes an execution-only composition compiler-free. ADR 0001 revision 5 authorises the growth.

JS-1 adds the two composition roots ADR 0001 revision 6 authorises - an execution-only root and a slice-compiler root - taking the graph from 17 projects and 46 edges to 19 and 55. It adds ZERO packable assemblies. The two are separate projects rather than two modes of one because their REFERENCE SETS differ by the lowering, which is the whole of the execution-only claim: that root names the profile and not the compiler, so it cannot turn source into an artifact however it is invoked, and every artifact it runs is precompiled and read as bytes.

JS-3a adds the conformance harness, which ADR 0001's revision of 2026-09-03 authorises: a composition root that is NEVER ADVERTISED, taking the graph from 20 projects and 59 edges to 21 and 64. It adds ZERO packable assemblies. Its reference set is the slice-compiler root's, because scoring a conformance test means lowering it - and rule N13 is what holds the consequence: the harness, and any suite it reads, appear in no package and in no advertised composition's closure, and no other project references it in either direction.
